name: Suzuki V-Strom 1000 / 1050
engine: 996 or 1037 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected
intro: Suzuki's big V-twin adventure bike. Many years have electrical recalls, mostly the regulator/rectifier and wiring.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2008-2009 bikes are in recall 11V108 and 2008-2012 bikes in recall 16V018 (regulator/rectifier). 2014-2016 bikes have several electrical recalls: the wiring harness can rub through on the fuel tank, the battery ground can corrode, and the ignition switch can corrode. 2020-2025 DL1050s are in recall 25V505 (headlight high beam too bright).
A-002.reason: A failed regulator or shorted harness can strand you or stall the bike. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Weak bond between the regulator/rectifier power board and its case lets heat deform the board.
Regulator/rectifier circuit board can lift off its case, so the battery stops charging and the engine can stall.
Headlight upper beam is too bright to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the headlight assembly free.

known.title: 2014-2016 electrical recalls
known.what: 2014-2016 DL1000s have recalls for harness chafing on the fuel tank, the battery ground connection and ignition switch corrosion.
